The young lady Duan next door is said to have been recuperating here for a long time, yet she never seems to improve. 
Although I have not lived here long and have only examined her pulse a handful of times... the illness she suffers from is truly rare! In my opinion, it is not caused by exposure to cold or heat, but likely the soul-separation illness! 
I observe her spirit restless, her wandering soul like drifting willow catkins, the qi of her triple burner scattered... When I checked her pulse, she told me she often stays awake all night... feeling as if her body splits in two, her soul flying away from it... 
Alas, her heart longs to travel far, yet she is confined to a sickbed. How pitiable! 
Tomorrow, I shall consult the principles of medicine to question the origins of her constitution, and plan to use a Soul Reviving Pill to strengthen her foundation, aided by Du Huo Decoction to alleviate stagnation.
